reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life. This is a trend that has both positive and negative effects on consumers and society.

On the one hand, advertisements can be very convenient and helpful for consumers. Firstly, they provide people with useful information about different products and services. For example, advertisements on social media can show customers a wide range of goods, which helps them compare products and make better purchasing decisions. Secondly, advertising can contribute to economic development. When companies advertise their products, they can attract more customers and increase their sales. As a result, businesses may expand and create more employment opportunities for local people.

On the other hand, there are also some disadvantages of having too many advertisements. One problem is that advertising can persuade people to buy things that they do not really need. Attractive pictures and famous people can influence consumers, especially young people, and encourage them to make impulsive purchases. This may lead to wasteful spending habits. Another disadvantage is that people are sometimes bombarded with advertisements. For instance, users may see many pop-up advertisements while using social media or watching videos online. This can interrupt their activities and make them feel annoyed.

In conclusion, the increasing number of advertisements has both advantages and disadvantages. Although advertisements provide useful information and support economic development, they can also encourage unnecessary spending and disturb people's daily activities.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
Advertisements are becoming increasingly common in everyday life. This trend has both positive and negative effects on consumers and society.

On the one hand, the growing prevalence of advertising is beneficial to both consumers and the economy. From consumers’ perspective, advertisements provide useful information about different products and services. For example, TV advertisements, pop-ups on social networking platforms and street billboards expose customers to a wide range of goods available on the market, helping them compare products and make wiser purchasing decisions. On a wider societal scale, advertising can be a powerful driver of economic growth. With engaging content and appealing visual effects, advertisements can stimulate customers’ demand and purchasing power, increasing production. As a result, businesses may expand, creating more employment opportunities and generating greater revenue for the state budget.

On the other hand, advertising also has some disadvantages. Persuasive advertisements can lure people into buying things that they may not otherwise need. Celebrity endorsements can make promoted products appear more trustworthy and desirable, encouraging consumers, especially young people, to make impulsive and wasteful purchases. Another disadvantage is that people are sometimes bombarded with advertisements. For instance, social network users may see incessant pop-ups while they are watching videos online and may be unable to turn them off immediately. This disrupts their online experience and makes them feel annoyed.

In conclusion, the increasing number of advertisements has both advantages and disadvantages. Although advertisements provide useful information and support economic development, they can also encourage unnecessary spending and disturb people’s daily activities.

reviews.question:
The media should include more stories which report good news.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
opinion because good news can have some benefits, although negative news is also important.

On the one hand, reporting more good news can make people feel more positive about society. There are many stories about people helping others, successful projects, or improvements in different areas. These stories can give people hope and encourage them to do positive things. For example, when people hear about volunteers helping poor communities, they may become more willing to help others. In addition, too much negative news can make people feel worried or stressed about the world around them.

On the other hand, negative news should not be ignored because it helps people understand real problems. News about crime, natural disasters, pollution or political issues can warn people about possible dangers. It can also encourage governments and communities to take action. If the media only focuses on good news, people may have an unrealistic view of society and may not know about serious problems that need attention.

In conclusion, I agree that the media should include more good news because it can create a more positive atmosphere. However, negative stories are still necessary, so the media should provide a reasonable balance between positive and negative news.
reviews.overall: Em đã nêu được một lợi ích của tin tốt và tác dụng cảnh báo của tin xấu, nhưng bài lại chọn đồng ý trong khi dàn ý yêu cầu không đồng ý. Body 1 chưa phản biện tính khả thi của việc đăng thêm tin tốt; hai đoạn cũng chưa có ví dụ Nick Vujicic và tai nạn do lái xe khi say theo bài học. reviews.suggestedRevision:
Some people argue that news outlets should publish more uplifting stories. I am firmly convinced that this proposal is unwise, although positive reports can offer certain benefits.

Admittedly, reporting more good news can help people adopt a more optimistic view of life. Stories about people overcoming hardship may give readers hope. For example, Nick Vujicic was born without arms or legs, yet he did not give up and became a world-famous motivational speaker who now travels around the world to inspire others. Moreover, negative news should not be ignored because it warns people about existing and possible dangers. reviews.question:
Some scientists think there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
Some scientists believe that there may be intelligent life on other planets and humans should send messages to contact them. However, other scientists think that this could be dangerous. This essay will discuss both views and explain why I believe that contacting aliens should be done very carefully.

On the one hand, sending messages to other planets could bring many benefits. If intelligent life exists outside Earth, contacting them could help scientists learn more about the universe. They might have advanced knowledge and technology that humans do not have. For example, communication with another civilization could give us new ideas about science, medicine or space travel. Moreover, finding intelligent life would be an important discovery for humanity and could help answer questions about whether humans are alone in the universe.

On the other hand, there are some possible dangers. Firstly, humans do not know whether these life forms would be friendly or dangerous. If they have much more advanced technology, they could potentially cause problems for Earth. Secondly, sending messages tells unknown civilizations that intelligent life exists on our planet. This could make Earth a target if they have harmful intentions. Therefore, some scientists believe that it is safer to observe other planets instead of trying to contact them.

In my opinion, I agree more with the second view. Although contacting intelligent life could provide valuable knowledge, the possible risks are difficult to predict. Scientists should continue studying the universe, but they should be extremely careful before sending direct messages to unknown civilizations.

Body 1 cần nối các vấn đề môi trường có thể đe dọa loài người với khả năng học cách khắc phục từ nền văn minh khác; Body 2 cần giải thích khoảng cách công nghệ, nguy cơ bị lợi dụng và bị xâm lược. Quan điểm của em cũng cần nhất quán là không nên gửi thông điệp, thay vì chỉ gửi một cách thận trọng. Cô yêu cầu em viết lại theo các bước ấy và nộp lại.

reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
Powerful advertising can have negative effects on individuals. This essay will discuss the main problems caused by advertising and suggest some solutions to reduce these effects.

On the one hand, advertising can negatively affect people in several ways. Firstly, it encourages people to buy unnecessary products. Many advertisements use attractive images and famous people to persuade customers to purchase things they do not really need. As a result, people may waste money and face financial problems. Secondly, advertising can make people feel dissatisfied with their lives because they often compare themselves with the perfect images shown in advertisements.

On the other hand, there are some solutions to this problem. Firstly, governments should introduce stricter laws to control advertisements, especially those that contain false information or make unrealistic promises. Companies should provide honest information about their products. Secondly, schools and parents should teach young people how to think critically about advertisements. This can help them make better decisions and avoid buying things simply because they are popular.

In conclusion, advertising can lead to unnecessary spending and dissatisfaction. However, these problems can be reduced through stricter government regulations and better education.
reviews.overall: Em đã trả lời đúng hai câu hỏi, có câu chủ đề cho từng Body và giải thích khá rõ tác hại mua sắm không cần thiết. Tuy nhiên, bài mới có 189 từ, thiếu 61 từ so với mức tối thiểu. Ý so sánh bản thân với hình ảnh hoàn hảo còn thiếu bước giải thích; các biện pháp ở Body 2 cũng chưa chỉ rõ cách xử lý từng tác hại em nêu. Cô yêu cầu em phát triển hai chuỗi này và nộp lại bài đủ 250 từ.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, video games have become increasingly popular among people of different ages. Some people believe that they are a good way to relax and learn new skills, while others think they can have negative effects on players. In my opinion, the drawbacks of video games outweigh their benefits.

On the one hand, video games can bring several benefits. Firstly, they allow players to enter a virtual world and experience exciting activities, such as racing or shooting, which are difficult to do in real life. This can help people relax after a stressful day. Secondly, some games require players to think carefully and develop strategies to win. As a result, they can improve problem-solving and decision-making skills. However, people can develop these abilities through other activities, such as playing team sports or joining debate clubs.

On the other hand, playing video games too much can cause serious problems. Many games use scores, rewards and frequent challenges to encourage players to continue playing for hours. For example, children may spend too much time trying to complete levels or achieve higher scores than their friends. This can lead to gaming addiction, which may cause a lack of sleep and reduce physical activity. Moreover, students who spend too much time playing games may neglect their homework and get lower marks at school.

In conclusion, although video games can provide entertainment and help players develop certain skills, I believe their disadvantages are greater than their advantages. This is because their benefits can be gained through other activities, while excessive gaming can negatively affect people's health and academic performance.

reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, scientists and tourists can travel to remote natural areas, such as the South Pole. Although some people may think this development has negative effects, I believe it is a positive development because it provides tourists with new experiences and helps scientists make important discoveries.

On the one hand, travelling to remote areas allows tourists to explore new places and learn about different cultures. Although there are many famous tourist attractions around the world, some travellers still want to visit places that few people have seen before. For example, tourists visiting a remote island may have the chance to meet local people, try traditional food and learn about their way of life. These experiences are often more interesting than simply watching travel programmes on television because visitors can experience everything in person.

On the other hand, access to remote areas also brings significant benefits to scientists. By visiting these places, they can study natural environments and find answers to important scientific questions. For instance, scientists can discover new viruses in remote forests or study the lives of rare animals in deep oceans. This research helps people understand potential health risks and environmental problems. As a result, scientists can prepare for possible disease outbreaks and find ways to protect wildlife and restore damaged habitats.

In conclusion, I believe that allowing people to travel to remote natural areas is a positive development. It gives tourists valuable experiences and enables scientists to make important discoveries that can benefit both humans and the natural environment.

outlineCoverage.comment: Em có virus, động vật hiếm, chuẩn bị đối phó dịch và phục hồi môi trường sống. Em chưa nêu virus mới xuất hiện định kỳ, tác động của nóng lên toàn cầu, hoặc mức nguy hiểm của những đợt dịch có thể giết hàng triệu người; vì thế chuỗi ví dụ đến hệ quả chưa đủ.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [ex] see this in the way novel viruses break out every once in a while, and how global warming is affecting lives and habitats of elusive animals in heavily wooded areas and deep under the sea → understand more about such phenomena - far more prepared for potential outbreaks - kill millions in the future + help restore damaged habitats

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: I believe it is a positive development because it provides tourists with new experiences and helps scientists make important discoveries.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: I believe it is a positive development because it provides tourists with new experiences and helps scientists make important discoveries.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Em giữ được quan điểm và hai hướng giải thích; bản sửa phát triển các bước trung gian trong từng Body để hai lợi ích này có chứng cứ.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: This research helps people understand potential health risks and environmental problems.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: Through this research, the risks posed by emerging viruses and the effects of global warming on habitats can be better understood.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Cô giữ nghĩa nghiên cứu giúp hiểu vấn đề, đổi sang bị động để nhấn mạnh điều được tìm hiểu và dùng can để diễn đạt khả năng.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: On the one hand, travelling to remote areas allows tourists to explore new places and learn about different cultures.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: To begin with, travelling to remote areas allows tourists to explore new places and learn about different cultures.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Câu mở Body 1 vẫn bao quát lợi ích du lịch; bản sửa nối hai đoạn như hai lợi ích cùng chiều.

appliedKnowledge.sourceLocator: Foundation 6, Buổi 26, P6–20; dàn ý Remote areas P070–P072
appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: These experiences are often more interesting than simply watching travel programmes on television because visitors can experience everything in person.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: Granted, some might argue that these sights and activities can be seen on television travel programmes.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Cô chuyển ý xem truyền hình thành lời của người khác trước khi bác bằng trải nghiệm trực tiếp.

appliedKnowledge.sourceLocator: Foundation 6, Buổi 26, dàn ý Remote areas P073–P075
appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: For instance, scientists can discover new viruses in remote forests or study the lives of rare animals in deep oceans.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: For instance, researchers can investigate the periodic emergence of new viruses and examine how global warming affects elusive animals and their habitats in dense forests and deep oceans.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Bản sửa giữ hai hướng nghiên cứu em đã có và bổ sung hiện tượng virus mới, tác động của nóng lên toàn cầu theo ví dụ được giao.
